# write_sync_attrs { #lfpack.write_sync_attrs }

```python
write_sync_attrs(meta_group, sample_knots, time_knots)
```

Write ALF sync knots plus a derived affine summary to a ``meta`` HDF5 group.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type       | Description                                                                                                                              | Default    |
|--------------|------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| meta_group   | h5py.Group | The scale's ``meta`` group (``f'{recording}/{scale:02d}/meta'``).                                                                        | _required_ |
| sample_knots | array_like | Sample-index knots, in this scale's own native sample-index units (rate-scaled per scale, matching the existing ``fs_sync`` convention). | _required_ |
| time_knots   | array_like | Session-clock time knots [s], one per ``sample_knots`` entry.                                                                            | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                     | Description                                                                                                                                                                            |
|--------|--------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | t0_sync, fs_sync : float | The least-squares affine derived from the knots and written alongside them, so ``.t0``/``.fs`` and any direct-attrs reader (e.g. ``qc_report.py``) keep seeing a plain scalar summary. |

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type       | Description            |
|--------|------------|------------------------|
|        | ValueError | See `_validate_knots`. |
